attributes.board_name: Connecticut Department of Public Health (Board of Examiners of Psychologists)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses, seminars, workshops, conferences, postdoctoral institutes offered or approved by APA, a regionally accredited graduate program, a nationally recognized CE provider, DMHAS, or a recognized behavioral science organization; research-based conference presentations (max 5)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from CE at the first license renewal.
rules.alternatives: An ABPP diploma earned during the registration period substitutes for that period's CE.
rules.audit_note: Keep certificates at least 3 years after the renewal date; submit to DPH on request.
rules.notes: Max 5 CE units by asynchronous online/home study; at least 5 by synchronous (live) online education. Veterans topic: first renewal period with CE, then at least once every 6 years (incl. PTSD, suicide risk screening and suicide prevention). 1 unit = 50-60 min.
